item.subject: science
item.stem:
Simran studies four Class 7 topics in one week: how vinegar reacts with baking soda, how a green leaf makes food in light, how a metal pan heats on a stove, and how seasons change as Earth moves around the Sun.

Which claims are correct? One or more options may be correct.

options.A: These topics belong to different fields of science but are connected ways of studying the same world.
options.B: Looking across materials, living things, heat, and Earth motion can show links between the topics.
options.C: Materials and living things are connected, but heat and Earth motion are isolated topics.
options.D: Topics from different chapters must be treated as isolated subjects.
